sections.heading: Disease-Stricken Stray Dog's Recovery
paragraphs: A story about a stray dog covered in scabs due to mange has captured the hearts of many in Belgium, according to Woopets. The dog, initially in poor condition, has now been cured and permanently adopted, as shared in a video.
